capabilities: Chat with the Claude Code agent in a sidebar on desktop and mobile
Stream replies, thinking, tool calls and the agent's todo list
Approve or deny destructive file edits and shell commands
Switch, rename, archive and delete server-side sessions
Export conversations to Markdown notes or insert links to them
extras: Self-hosted: needs a Linux server with Node.js 20+ and Claude Code signed in; without it the sidebar is empty. The agent is not sandboxed to the vault, so keep backups. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic. Only tested on iOS; Windows host unsupported; install via BRAT until it reaches the community directory.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Claude chat, and Claude Code runs only in a terminal on one machine, so sessions stop when the device sleeps.

relations.evidence: behind a chat UI instead of a terminal
Same sessions as the claude CLI.
Your devices talk to your server over your own Tailscale network.

summary: Self-hosted Obsidian sidebar that chats with the Claude Code agent over a WebSocket server, keeping sessions alive across devices and app restarts.
